117697.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Central New York
117697.note: The Daily Orange on COLlive, 22 Nov 2017 ('New Shluchim Join at Syracuse'): Rabbi Yaakov Rapoport 'has been involved with the house since its creation 36 years ago'; 'SU's Chabad House was formed in 1981.' COLlive, 10 Aug 2023 ('New Shluchim to Syracuse University'): 'The Chabad House there was opened in 1981 under the direction of Rabbi Yaakov and Chanie Rapoport to serve all of Central New York with a focus on Syracuse University.' The 1984 Lubavitch list has the 'Chabad House of Syracuse' at 211 Lockwood Rd. Medium: a Daily Orange article on CrownHeights.info (10 Feb 2006) says instead 'Chabad has been in Syracuse since 1984', and a Hamilton College profile has Rabbi Rapoport moving to Syracuse in 1991 (which the 1984 list rules out as the start).

earlier.where: the Chabad House of Syracuse, 211 Lockwood Rd. (the 1984 Lubavitch list, p. 46)

158198.name: Chabad at Syracuse University
158198.note: The Daily Orange on COLlive, 22 Nov 2017 ('New Shluchim Join at Syracuse'): 'SU's Chabad House was formed in 1981'; Rabbi Yaakov Rapoport 'has been involved with the house since its creation 36 years ago'. COLlive, 10 Aug 2023: 'The Chabad House there was opened in 1981 under the direction of Rabbi Yaakov and Chanie Rapoport to serve all of Central New York with a focus on Syracuse University'; Rabbi Mendy and Lakey Rapoport now direct Chabad SU. Medium: a 2006 Daily Orange article (on CrownHeights.info) says 'Chabad has been in Syracuse since 1984'. Its own chabad.org listing went up 2 Aug 2004.
